cases.requirement: Make the batch limit configurable per client. AC-01: Given a batch size equal to the client's limit, When the batch is submitted, Then it is accepted. AC-02: Given a batch size above the client's limit, When the batch is submitted, Then CheckLimit returns ErrLimitExceeded.

AC-01: Given an authenticated customer who owns project X, When they request X's report for a month, Then the report is returned. Customers may read only their own projects, as on every other project endpoint.

context_slices.note: GetExports and DeleteProject in the same file use the same caller/OwnerID check.

context_slices.code: r.Get("/projects/{id}/report", h.GetReport) // authenticated customer route, no per-project middleware

cases.requirement: AC-01: Given a transient upstream error (timeout or 503), When an upload is submitted, Then the submission is retried up to 3 attempts in total. AC-02: One Upload.ID never creates more than one upstream upload.

AC-01: Given an import whose store write succeeds, When it completes, Then the import_completed metric is incremented. Existing behaviour stays: a store write failure returns an error and the import is not COMPLETED.
AC-01: Given a completed export with an upstream reference, When GET /exports/{id} is called, Then the response includes upstream_reference. Exports without a reference omit the field.
Rename the metric search_suggestions to search_suggestions_total. No behaviour change. The dashboard and alert already query the new name.
Readability cleanup: rename the local accumulator in SumEntries. No behaviour change.

AC-01: Given a daily or monthly report with at least one export, When the summary is built, Then AverageMs equals TotalMs / Count, truncated to whole milliseconds. Periods with zero exports keep returning ErrNoExports (unchanged).

context_slices.note: Repository search: newSummary is called only from Daily and Monthly; averageMs only from newSummary.
